description: This Java class defines a 'Device' object representing an authenticated client device within the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages device identity, authorities, and related metadata extracted from JSON Web Tokens (JWT). The class provides constructors for creating device instances from tokens or explicit identifiers, along with methods to access device info and verify authorities.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents an authenticated device with identity and authority information extracted from a JWT token or provided identifiers.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Device instance from a JWT token, extracting tenant, device ID, and authorities.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Device instance from tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Builds a JsonObject with tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Checks if the device has a specific authority.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the device's principal information.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from the device's principal.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID from the device's principal.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the device ID, as per Principal interface.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the device's tenant and device ID.

methods.name: asAddress (static)
methods.description: Creates an address string from tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: asAddress (static overload)
